Ambient-aware ligand-receptor inference between clusters ("chirp").

Source: R/chirp.R
chirp.Rd

For each gene and cluster, compares the observed cluster total with the count ambient RNA is expected to contribute, sum_c rho_c * T_c * soup_g (per sample when soup has one column per sample). A gene counts as natively expressed in a cluster when the observed total is significantly above margin times that expectation (Poisson upper tail, Benjamini-Hochberg across genes x clusters). Pair scores use native expression, the observed total minus the expected ambient count, per 10,000 native UMIs.

Usage

chirp(
  observed,
  pairs,
  fit = NULL,
  soup = NULL,
  rho = NULL,
  clusters = NULL,
  sample_of = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  margin = 2,
  min_native = 1
)

Arguments

observed

genes x cells raw counts (matrix or dgCMatrix), uncorrected.

pairs

data.frame with columns ligand and receptor (gene names matching rownames(observed)). A multi-subunit receptor or ligand can be given as genes joined by "+"; the complex is scored by its least expressed subunit and called only if every subunit is called.

fit

optional decant object; supplies soup, rho and clusters when those are not given.

soup

ambient profile: a length-genes vector, or genes x samples matrix with sample_of.

rho

per-cell (or scalar) contamination fraction.

clusters

length-cells cluster labels.

sample_of

length-cells sample index into the columns of soup (required when soup has more than one column).

alpha

FDR level for the native-expression call.

margin

multiplier on the expected ambient count before testing. The default, 2, kept false calls at zero in simulations with rho underestimated by a third; it does not protect if rho is half its true value. Lower it for more sensitivity only if rho is trusted.

min_native

minimum native expression, in counts per 10,000 native UMIs, for a call.

Value

data.frame, one row per pair x sender x receiver, sorted by score: ligand, receptor, sender, receiver, score (geometric mean of native ligand in sender and native receptor in receiver), call (both sides natively expressed), naive_score (same on raw counts), naive_call (both sides detected in at least 10% of cells, the usual rule), ambient_share_ligand (expected ambient share of the ligand counts in the sender) and p_ligand, p_receptor (BH-adjusted). Rows with naive_call & !call are the interactions ambient RNA would have produced. Attribute "native": genes x clusters native expression.

Examples

sim <- simulate_experiment(n_genes = 200, n_types = 4, n_cells = 300, seed = 1)
g <- rownames(sim$observed)
pairs <- data.frame(ligand = g[1:5], receptor = g[6:10])
res <- chirp(sim$observed, pairs, soup = ambient_global(sim$empty),
             rho = sim$rho_true, clusters = sim$labels)
head(res[res$call, ])
